Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman visits France for economic talks

India's Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has commenced a four-day visit to France. The trip includes the India-France Economic and Financial Dialogue, meetings with investors, and discussions on technology and innovation, aiming to deepen the economic partnership between the two nations.
